label: Triangle Pocket
description: A triangle chest pocket tapers to a single point at the bottom, forming a pointed V-shaped base rather than a flat or rounded edge. This sharp, angular shape is a bolder, more eye-catching detail that draws attention to the breast. It gives the shirt a more vintage or stylized character compared with the standard rounded pocket.
